title: Quasi-random splitting method for accurate and efficient multiphysics simulation
summary: We propose a quasi-random operator splitting method for evolution equations driven by multiple mechanisms. The method uses a one-dimensional low-discrepancy sequence to determine the ordering of the subflows through a direct point-to-permutation construction, while applying each subflow exactly once per time step. Thus, for a decomposition into \(p\) operators, the proposed method requires only \(p\) subflow evaluations per step, compared with essentially \(2p-2\) evaluations for the classical multi-operator Strang splitting when \(p\geq 3\).
